snippet.title: Dragon Ball Kai: Ultimate Butouden (DS) - Japanese Trailer Compilation
snippet.description:
**WARNING** May include spoilers for those who have not seen the Dragon Ball Z series

Trailer #1 is from 0:00-0:15, Trailer #2 is from 0:15-2:10, and Trailer #3 is from 2:11 to the end. 

Featuring gameplay from what appears to be throughout the entire series. And yes, Cell was holding a DS around 2:15 O_o

Title: Dragon Ball Kai: Ultimate Butouden
Developer: Namco Bandai
Publisher: Namco
System: Nintendo DS
Release Date: February 3, 2011 (Japan)
Official website: http://www.bandaigames.channel.or.jp/list/ds_dragonball_kai/

With regards to GameTrailers
